title: Rocket Roadster Risk Quote
one_liner: A tongue-in-cheek insurance calculator for cars with strapped-on rocket thrusters and 2G fan-suction levitation.
speaker: Hosts
context: After watching Tesla's flying Roadster demo do 0-60 in under a second and hover upside down via thrusters, the hosts joke that no insurer would touch it and ask what coverage would even cost.
demo: User picks a trim (Performance/Thrust/Rocket) or enters custom 0-60 time, top speed, and toggles like 'has rocket thrusters' and 'can fly upside down.' The page spits out an escalating, satirically-worded premium quote and a list of exclusions ('voids coverage if thrusters engaged above 2G'), with a gauge that maxes out and breaks for the Rocket trim.
data_plan: User input; underlying premium formula is a simple weighted multiplier built from the real specs stated on the podcast (0.6-1.6s 0-60, 230mph top speed, 380km/h rocket trim), clearly a simulated/joke calculation.
risks: Purely satirical numbers could be mistaken for real insurance guidance; should be labeled clearly as a joke calculator.

episode.title: Flying Tesla Car, Robot Brains Halving in Cost Every 3 Weeks, and Why Incentives Decide AI Alignment | #303
